summary: Implemented the TimeElapsedColumn feature across rich/progress.py, rich/palette.py (Palette.__rich__), rich/default_styles.py (progress.elapsed yellow), CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased Added entry), tests/test_progress.py (new test_time_elapsed_column plus regenerated test_columns expected output), and new tests/test_palette.py (test_rich_cast). No tests were run; the test_columns expected output was derived by hand-tracing the mock clock. One deviation to review: in the frame-B refresh the bar shrinks by 7 instead of 8 because the speed column narrows from 9 to 8 characters after the speed values change. Nothing was committed.
